recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not make broad source edits for FHIR-7622; future changes to individual note/comment elements should be handled under their own work-group trackers when they intentionally deviate from the old general convention.
issue_request: FHIR-7622 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification disposition for DSTU1. It requested structured note support by defining a common Annotation datatype, making note elements 0..* Annotation, disallowing plural notes/comments names, and keeping comment elements as 0..1 string with MnM confirmation warnings for exceptions.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit e86f20cfb9b7f9336b4463ff3ee5f44691a937bf, titled '#7622 - add data type Annotation', matching Jira's svn revision 5620 application note. That commit added source/datatypes/annotation.xml and registered Annotation in source/fhir.ini; current fhir.ini still actively lists Annotation as a datatype and marks it normative.
additional_context: Current Annotation source preserves the requested author[x] 0..1, time 0..1, text 1..1 structure and usage guidance. A targeted scan of base StructureDefinitions found no plural notes/comments, 60 base note elements as 0..* Annotation, and comment elements as 0..1 string or later-approved 0..1 markdown. The only base note markdown exception, DetectedIssue.mitigation.note, is already represented by the later FHIR-39405 fix on the combined branch; AppointmentResponse.comment markdown is likewise represented by FHIR-39557. FHIR-9384 later rejected renaming note elements to annotation, supporting the current naming convention.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the seed request is already reflected in active source and later element-specific decisions explain the observed deviations.
